# credit_risk_admission

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Turns counterparty credit risk into an explicit admission decision that can refuse unsafe payment exposure.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | `string` | yes | Required credit risk admission input; omission is an executable typed refusal, never an inferred approval. |
| `risk_band` | `string` | yes | Required credit risk admission input; omission is an executable typed refusal, never an inferred approval. |
| `decision` | `string` | yes | Immutable decision or evidence identity used to verify and replay this bounded commercial admission. |
